title: Woman with paralysis communicates through a brain-controlled avatar
summary: For a participant with stroke-related paralysis, an electrode array on the cortex and AI algorithms translated attempted speech into text, synthetic voice and avatar movements. Text reached nearly 80 words per minute after individual training. Experimental study in one person; the system requires a physical connection to computers.
ai_technology: Neural speech decoding and AI facial animation
organization: UC San Francisco and UC Berkeley
